item.title: 23 Laws Of Interesting
item.author: massimo.nocentini@gmail.com (Massimo Nocentini)
item.description: This manifesto argues that interesting things happen when people deliberately seek novelty, step outside comfort zones, cultivate curiosity, listen well, embrace their peculiarities, and stay open to failure, connection, and experimentation. Being interesting is presented not as a fixed trait, but as a practice of living bravely, learning widely, and creating original paths instead of copying inherited ones.

item.title: Manifesto Of A DOer
item.author: massimo.nocentini@gmail.com (Massimo Nocentini)
item.description: This manifesto presents a practical ethic of action centered on focus, urgency, disciplined execution, adaptability, and meaningful change. It argues that ideas matter only when carried through by consistent effort, clear priorities, resilient teams, and the willingness to embrace obstacles, rest, failure, and responsibility in service of something that truly matters.
